versions.subject: New Linux Auditd Rules - Steghide Steganography
versions.detection:
type: 
    type: EXECVE
commands:
    a0: steghide
    a1: embed
a2:
    a2:
      - '-cf'
      - '-ef'
a4:
    a4:
      - '-cf'
      - '-ef'
condition: type and commands and a2 and a4
versions.spl: type="EXECVE" a0="steghide" a1="embed" a2 IN ("-cf", "-ef") a4 IN ("-cf", "-ef")
